caption: The drawing depicts a knee-length, sleeveless cape as the central object. The main section of the cape is dark reddish-burgundy and features vertical pleats starting from the shoulders, with darker shading near the collar, possibly indicating decorative texture or yoke. Beneath the cape, a lighter, cream-colored garment is visible, indicating that the cape is open at the front. The collar is rounded and matches the burgundy of the cape, and the overall hem of the cape is curved but even. Behind the main colored image, to the upper right, there is a faint, unfinished line drawing of the same cape, showing its outline and basic structure without color. The backdrop is a plain, neutral light beige. No other objects or elements are present in the drawing.
title: Cape
